dedupe_keys.name: nigerian energy infrastructure attacks and oil loss estimates 2009 2025

description: This collection links reported attacks on Nigerian energy infrastructure with annual oil-loss and revenue estimates. University of Oxford researchers compiled 161 georeferenced incidents from 2011–2025 and annual losses covering 2009–2025 from open reporting and industry sources. National coverage includes oil and gas assets and electricity transmission across six geopolitical zones. Zenodo provides CSV tables, an XLSX workbook, a notebook and figures free under CC BY 4.0. The associated GitHub repository exposes data and script directories but states no separate code licence. Aggregated estimates, incomplete incident reporting and state-level locations are limitations for asset-specific risk modelling. A result filename explicitly contains placeholder, so calculated impacts should not be treated as observed outages. Modellers could construct disruption scenarios or compare historical exposure assumptions with electricity-system simulations such as model-pypsa. The 2016 Forcados and 2024 Shiroro examples are part of this collection. No incident rows or notebook calculations were downloaded or reproduced.
name: Nigerian energy-infrastructure attacks and oil-loss estimates, 2009–2025
